svg.title: H446 2023 Board grid 10 by 20 question
svg.desc: A real 10x20 grid of 200 blank source-defined cells, labelled row0..9 and column0..19. Task asks for nested loops and blank Artifact objects; no loop bounds or sentinel values are revealed on the question view.
svg.text: How will the Board constructor initialise every grid entry?
Complete the nested FOR loops and empty Artifact creation.
